test-report-setup.install: Install Node.js 22 or later on the runner and use node:test in the project.
test-report-setup.configure: Save this local test configuration. The runner tests an isolated code revision and assigns a fresh report path.
test-report-setup.register: Report the observed capability, then have an administrator register and enable it. Select this fixed profile on the workflow test node.
test-report-setup.policy: Collects a report for a fixed code revision. Discovery is not proof of test execution; test outcomes and human acceptance are separate facts.
test-report-setup.open_plan: Open test plan and case results
